_comment: Millersville Business Association (MBA) integration data — the SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for membership. Hand-maintained; source roster at millersvillebiz.com. Place listings (restaurants.json/services.json) carry NO membership fields — app.js derives 'Verified MBA Member' badge + enhanced listing + spotlight status at render time by matching this roster against listings via the 'matchListing' name key. This means you edit ONE list when membership changes; the Directory follows automatically and can never drift. Holds: (1) the canonical member roster with tier, (2) spotlight-only institutions that aren't Directory places (MU/PM/Borough), (3) homepage Spotlight rotation content for members who bought the paid Featured Spotlight add-on, and (4) audience targeting for the rotation. Revenue model: MBA collects the Spotlight fee, split 25% MBA / 75% site. Featured Spotlight = homepage rotation + live-content scraping + enhanced listing; offered where feasible (scraping is per-business custom work). A validator should warn if any matchListing/directoryFile fails to resolve to a real listing.
associationContact: Millersville Business Association, P.O. Box 163, Millersville, PA 17551
_audienceComment: audience targeting mirrors the app's existing muAffiliation convention: 'townie' (local) vs 'student' (marauder), and IMPORTANTLY unset affiliation is treated as 'student'/marauder everywhere in app.js (see effectiveAffiliation pattern). Values: 'locals' (townies only), 'marauders' (students + unset only), 'both' (everyone). A local-targeted business will NOT show to undecided/unset visitors since unset=marauder — consistent with the rest of the app.
_rosterComment: Full MBA member roster. tier: 'executive' | 'general'. matchListing (optional) links to an existing restaurants.json/services.json entry by exact name so the badge can be applied there. directoryFile tells which file the listing lives in. spotlightOnly:true means this member is NOT a Directory place (institution with its own events/news visibility) but CAN appear in the rotation if they buy Spotlight.

_spotlightComment: Members who purchased the paid Featured Spotlight add-on. Only these appear in the homepage rotation. name must match a roster entry. audience targets the rotation per above. tagline is one short line. logo is a path under /img or similar (optional; falls back to styled name). link is the tap target (their site or their Directory anchor). liveFeed (optional) names a scraped data integration like John Herr's weekly ad — built per-business, where feasible.
